questions.question: What is the primary method to create a new array in JavaScript?

options.text: Using the Array constructor
Using the Object.create method
Using the JSON.parse method
Using the eval function

questions.explanation: The Array constructor is the primary method to create a new array in JavaScript. It can be used with or without the new keyword, and it can take multiple arguments to populate the array.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Array.prototype.push method?

options.text: To remove the last element from an array
To add one or more elements to the end of an array
To sort the elements of an array
To reverse the order of the elements in an array

questions.explanation: The Array.prototype.push method is used to add one or more elements to the end of an array. It returns the new length of the array.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Array.prototype.indexOf method?

options.text: To find the index of the first occurrence of a specified value in an array
To find the index of the last occurrence of a specified value in an array
To find the value of the first occurrence of a specified index in an array
To find the value of the last occurrence of a specified index in an array

questions.explanation: The Array.prototype.indexOf method is used to find the index of the first occurrence of a specified value in an array. It returns -1 if the value is not found.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Array.prototype.slice method?

options.text: To extract a section of an array and return it as a new array
To extract a section of an array and return it as a string
To extract a section of an array and return it as an object
To extract a section of an array and return it as a number

questions.explanation: The Array.prototype.slice method is used to extract a section of an array and return it as a new array. It does not modify the original array.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Array.prototype.splice method?

options.text: To add or remove elements from an array
To sort the elements of an array
To reverse the order of the elements in an array
To find the index of the first occurrence of a specified value in an array

questions.explanation: The Array.prototype.splice method is used to add or remove elements from an array. It returns an array of the removed elements.
